name: mixing_chamber_exergy
title: Exercise: mixing chamber of water and steam, exergy destruction
summary: Liquid water at 138 kPa and 10 °C mixes with steam at the same pressure and 115 °C. The outlet is at 55 °C and the chamber loses 3.16 kW to air at 21 °C. The model closes the steady mass and energy balances and reports the reversible power and the exergy destruction.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, MECA0002), repetition session 10, exercise 4 (2022-2023)

verification.summary: compare_solution.py --ees-units on R10_E04_2022.EES: 26 common variables, 13 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 5; only in CoolSolve: 1. Largest printed relative difference is 9.99e-01 on h_0: lowercase kj was not scaled. After x1000, Water h and s agree (max 5.3e-09). Air_ha h_0 is +126061 J/kg above EES; the psi shift cancels. m_dot_2, T_3 and X_destroyed_real agree (2.75e-10, 0, 1.60e-10).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of R10_E04_2022.EES (31 variables), compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: The tool summary is: 26 common variables, 13 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 5; only in CoolSolve: 1. max_rel_diff is 9.99e-01 on h_0, the largest relative difference the tool prints. EES stored h and s with lowercase unit kj, which --ees-units does not scale (it matches the token kJ). psi uses kJ and is scaled. After multiplying the unscaled kj values by 1000, Water enthalpies and entropies agree within 5.3e-09. Air_ha at the dead state is +126061.5 J/kg on h_0 and -2978.187 J/kg-K on s_0 (CoolSolve minus EES). Each psi is then 1002095.18 J/kg below EES, the same shift on all three streams, and it cancels in the exergy balance. Only in EES: phi_1, phi_2, phi_3, X_dot_in, X_dot_out (commented symbols, stored values of phi equal psi; X_dot_in and X_dot_out stay at the default 1). Only in CoolSolve: T_0_K. 8 iterations with the converted .initials, 27 without. Same solution.
